prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption, new_flow, finish, home, choose_path, and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
reorder and choose_path changes were helpful, winning Round 4 (+11.8% after noise correction).
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect, but underpredicted the winning reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +11.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 89.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery Clarification Banner: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing back into their account.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Creation Reorder: Reorder the flow so sign_in occurs after waiting, allowing users to experience pet setup before being prompted to create an account. (why: Sign in conversion is only 72.9% and moving account creation after users experience value improves overall completion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Creation Status Progress Indicator: Add a prominent progress bar and time estimate to the waiting screen so users know their pet is actively generating. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, indicating users are uncertain if pet creation is working.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Tip: Add photo upload guidelines and a visual tip carousel explaining optimal image lighting and formatting for pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Notification Completion Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts when pet rendering completes so users can switch windows while waiting. (why: Users take up to 2336s on average on the home/waiting step, indicating they leave the window while waiting.)

scores.note: Strong support email evidence (8 complaints) and 27.1% sign-in dropoff; simple copy fix.
Reordering showed strong results (+11.8%) in earlier tests, targeting 27.1% sign-in dropoff.
Funnel data shows high mean wait time (2336s); progress indicator clarifies status.
Adoption has highest funnel dropoff (39.1%) backed by 3 photo failure support emails.
Targets high mean wait time via notifications, but permission prompts may add mild friction.
